title: Scenario 10: Persistence via Scheduled Tasks
description: APT29 maintains persistence through scheduled tasks, registry modifications, and startup folders. Detecting these requires correlating multiple event types.
hunt_for: Execution of schtasks.exe, creation of scheduled tasks, or modifications to Run keys. Look for tasks that execute scripts or binaries from suspicious locations.
kibana_query: EventID:1 AND (Image:*schtasks.exe* OR CommandLine:*schtasks* OR CommandLine:*/create*)
detection_tips: Identify tasks executing from Temp or Public folders
Check for tasks running at unusual intervals
Correlate with recently created suspicious files
